name: File dropzone
description: A drop area with a small stack of paper that lifts on hover and fans out when files are dragged over, listing the chosen files below.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with every accepted file whenever the list changes. Files that break accept or maxSize stay in the list with a note and are left out.

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted types: extensions such as ".gpx", MIME types such as "image/png", or "image/*". Also limits the file picker.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow several files. When false, a new file replaces the list.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Largest file in bytes. Also writes the size limit into the default hint.

props.name: label
props.description: The main line under the paper stack. Also names the drop target for assistive technology.

props.name: hint
props.description: Replaces the muted line, which by default reads "or choose files" followed by the size limit.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Turns off dropping and choosing, and dims the component.
